title: AI Regulation Map: dataset
description: Weekly snapshot of the AI Regulation Map dataset (airegulationmap.org): the state of AI regulation in 196 countries, scored 1 to 5 on six dimensions (regulation status, policy lever, governance type, actor involvement, enforcement level, and a maturity index), with per-country descriptions, key legislation, source URLs, research confidence, the sub-indicator audit trail behind every score, and the full score history. The files are under public/: scores.csv, regulation_data.csv, history.json and data/subscores.json. Scores are assigned by an automated research pipeline (Claude with web search) against a fixed rubric, re-run weekly; the methodology, its limits, and the gold-set drift check are documented at airegulationmap.org/methodology.html. Each release is one ISO week's data commit; the concept DOI resolves to the latest.
